points.text: **Kotia** villages (**Koraput**, Odisha) row: Odisha-A.P. police face-off; SC **status quo order of 2006** stands.
ECI: re-enrolling via **Form 6** after SIR is not a false declaration under **Sec. 31, RP Act 1950**.
**Pilibhit** roll fraud: **Sec. 198 BNS** (public servant disobeying law) added; 2 EROs suspended.
SC on protests: a '**protest economy**' exists; Delhi Police say **Jantar Mantar** is a road, ~**1,300 protests/yr**.
**Olga Tellis (1985)**: right to livelihood is part of **Art. 21** — cited for slum rehabilitation.
Death penalty: **Bachan Singh (1980)** = 'rarest of rare'; **Manoj (2022)** = mental-health and conduct reports before sentencing.
Death-penalty sentencing needs a separate mitigation hearing; the **262nd Law Commission Report (2015)** urged abolition **except for terrorism**, finding no extra deterrence.
Welfare payments under the Panchayati Raj Ministry will use **EPIC + biometrics**, not **Aadhaar** (Minister **Rajiv Ranjan Singh**).
**16th Finance Commission**: **₹4,35,236 crore** for **2.55 lakh panchayats** (2026-31); urban bodies' share of local grants up to **45%**, plus a **₹10,000-crore urbanisation premium**.
**PAC** conference at Keralam Assembly (**Om Birla**): PAC has **22 members**, chair from the **Opposition** since 1967 — now **K.C. Venugopal**.
**RTE Act Sec. 27**: teachers may do non-teaching work only for **census, disaster relief and elections**; **Art. 21A** came by the **86th Amendment**.
Census town (**no municipal body**) = **5,000+ people, 400+/sq km, 75%+ male non-farm workers**; **74th Amendment (1992)**, **12th Schedule = 18 functions**.
Delhi moved the **jhuggi-jhopri** cut-off from 2006 to **1 Jan 2025** (~4 lakh families).
**Tata Motors** completed the **€3.8-bn** buy of Italy's **Iveco** — now world's **4th-largest** CV maker; **N. Chandrasekaran** chairs Iveco.
**SBI** Q2 profit **₹23,038 crore (+14.3%)**, GNPA **1.39%**; chairman **C.S. Setty**.
**IRDAI**: from **15 Dec 2026**, a **four-layer motor policy** for new vehicles (2 mandatory + 3 optional covers).
**PM Surya Ghar** (Feb 2024): **1 lakh** rooftop systems every 6 days; target **1 crore** homes by **31 Mar 2027**.
**NMDC** October iron ore output **+18%**; **Bailadila** (Chhattisgarh) dispatches hit by the **Kottavalasa-Kirandul** line washout.
Education loans: accounts down **15.2%** in 10 years, but average loan up **178%** to **₹7.25 lakh**.
Air India (CEO **Tewolde Gebremariam**) wants more widebodies; Adani tells foreign airlines to move to **Navi Mumbai** from April.
**Ganga Water Treaty** with Bangladesh expires **12 Dec 2026**; **Joint Rivers Commission (1972)** is the mechanism. Bangladesh PM: **Tarique Rahman**.
**ITBP DG Shatrujeet Singh Kapoor** confirmed PLA face-offs in **Arunachal** (Asaphila, Longju); key pacts **1993, 1996, 2005**; India rejects the '**1959 line**'.
Myanmar: junta chief **Min Aung Hlaing** is now President; ASEAN's **Five-Point Consensus** ignored; India eyes the **Kaladan** project (Kolkata-**Sittwe**-Mizoram).
**Mecca Agreement** (Saudi Arabia + Türkiye + Pakistan, Aug 2026) sent defence chiefs to **Tehran**.
US strikes on **Qeshm island** (Strait of Hormuz); Iran President **Masoud Pezeshkian**: war benefits 'no one'. Mediator: **Qatar**.
Trump: US ends **$4 bn/yr** aid to Israel from **2027** (Obama's 2016 MoU was **$38 bn/10 yrs**).
Ex-Maldives FM **Abdulla Shahid**, President of the **76th UNGA**, arrested on abuse charges.
**UNESCO** Constitution came into force **4 Nov 1946**; HQ **Paris**, DG **Khaled El-Enany**.
US **midterms**: all **435** House, **35/100** Senate seats, **36** Governorships; Senate was **53-47** Republican.
Iran backs the Mecca Agreement because it wants **region-led security** rather than US-led arrangements.
Drone killed an Indian seafarer off **Oman** (MSV Al Jusufi) — **23** Indian seafarers dead since Feb 2026.
**Indian Navy** + IAF rescued **20 Iranian crew** of the vessel *Azini* from pirates, 3,000 km off Mumbai.
Rajnath Singh at **Delhi Defence Dialogue**: aim for '**technological sovereignty**', not just making things here.
**COP31**: **Antalya, Türkiye**, **9-20 Nov 2026**. India wants a **Climate Finance Work Programme** and public finance under **Art. 9.1** of the Paris Agreement; COP30 was **Belém**.
Delhi AQI **350** ('very poor'). Bands: **201-300 poor, 301-400 very poor, 401-450 severe**.
**CSIR-NEERI** (Nagpur) green crackers cut particulates ~**30%**: **SWAS, STAR, SAFAL**, with a QR code on the pack.
Cyclone **Murasu** crossed near **Ongole** (Prakasam, A.P.): **2 dead**, **52,459 ha** of crops hit, **₹344 crore** loss.
North Indian Ocean cyclones are named by **IMD (RSMC New Delhi)** from the **WMO/ESCAP** panel list.
Avalanche on the **Kedartal** trek (**Uttarkashi**): 8 missing; treks above **4,000 m** suspended.
Tigress **'Dooars Rani'** (Bihar's **Valmiki** TR → Bengal's **Buxa** TR) strayed into Assam's **Raimona NP** and was brought back.
**Anthropic** told the US SEC that **AI systems helping design more capable AI** ('**recursive self-improvement**') may outpace safety work.
**Binance** repaid ~**95%** of the **$6.3-bn** hack from its **SAFU** fund; India taxes crypto at **30% + 1% TDS**.
*Current Biology*: a **Euhadra** snail's shell direction is set by the **mother's myosin gene**.
Mumbai protest over unpaid **Majhi Ladki Bahin** (**Maharashtra**) instalments (₹1,500; ₹2,100 promised), led by **AIDWA**.
Congress asked the **NHRC** to act on Prayagraj aspirants selling blood to pay coaching fees.
**4 Nov 1976**: **Jimmy Carter** elected the **39th US President**, beating Gerald Ford.
**World Day Against the Death Penalty**: **10 October**.
**NBT** survey (World Book Fair 2026): Gen Z buys global fiction and Korean works — **Han Kang**'s *The Vegetarian* (Booker 2016, Nobel 2024).
Meghalaya picked **11 villages** to preserve indigenous traditions.
**Prema Rawat** (Uttarakhand) hit the **fastest fifty in women's T20s — 14 balls**.
Youth Olympics (**Dakar**): **Khushbu Rajakbhai** judo silver (63kg), **Dhinidhi Desinghu** swimming bronze (100m free).
**Velavan Senthilkumar** won the **Czech Open** squash title (12th PSA crown).
ODIs in NZ: **Rohit Sharma** holds the highest ODI score (**264**), **Kohli** the most ODI tons (**55**); ball rule — two balls till the **34th over**.
India's **first overseas Test win** and series win: **New Zealand**, **Dunedin, Feb 1968**, under **Pataudi** (3-1).
Asian Champions Trophy semis move to **Mohali**: India vs **Korea**.
